local.h: CPS faces possible midyear cuts without state money
local.b: Chicago Public Schools has overspent its special education budget by $27 million as lawmakers open a veto session Tuesday, with low odds of more funding.
local.title: Without more state funding, CPS faces possible midyear cuts as unexpected costs mount

local.h: O'Hare, Midway cancellations continue after ground stop
local.b: By about 9:30 a.m. Saturday, 153 O'Hare departures had been canceled and 114 delayed, with 25 cancellations at Midway.
local.title: Cancellations, delays at O'Hare, Midway continue Saturday in fallout from FAA ground stop

local.h: Black Friday deals start earlier than ever
local.b: Retailers are launching holiday sales sooner to lure inflation-weary shoppers. A Deloitte survey says Chicago shoppers plan to spend $991 on retail goods this season.
local.title: It's true: Black Friday deals are starting even earlier than previous years

goodnews.h: First sea turtle eggs laid on SoCal beaches hatch
goodnews.b: Olive ridley eggs from Seal Beach hatched after 58 days, and the Aquarium of the Pacific released the hatchlings early Saturday.
goodnews.title: We’ve got baby turtles! First sea turtle eggs laid on SoCal beaches have hatched

local.h: Tech problems stall specialized high school test
local.b: The DOE will reschedule the SHSAT for students who couldn't finish after vendor Pearson reported technical issues; testing continues Nov. 15.
local.title: NYC's specialized high school test stalled by technical problems, DOE says

local.h: Brooklyn power plant expansion fuels data center fears
local.b: AlphaGen wants to expand two floating peaker plants near Sunset Park, prompting protests from environmentalists.
local.title: Expansion proposal for Brooklyn plants fuels data center fears

local.h: Hochul calls on Duffy to resign over FAA meltdown
local.b: The governor said the transportation secretary must resign or be removed after Friday's nationwide ground stop led to cancellations into Saturday.
local.title: Gov. Hochul calls on Duffy to resign after FAA meltdown grounds nation's flights

local.h: FAA meltdown strands Gov. Sherrill in Denver
local.b: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill was among the travelers stranded by Friday's nationwide ground stop while at a Democratic conference in Denver. She's now expected back Saturday morning.
local.title: FAA meltdown strands NJ Gov. Sherrill at Dem conference in Denver

goodnews.b: The nearly century-old Jersey City theater near Journal Square is welcoming the public back after five years closed, with two sold-out concerts this weekend.

local.h: Tens of thousands protest cost of living across France
local.b: About 106,000 people marched nationwide, including 24,000 in Paris, over rising prices and a new police bill, the interior ministry said.
local.title: IN PICTURES: French protesters chant against inflation and police
